title: Reading: Németh László on the Healer
goal: I can report what a text says about a writer's ideas (*A szöveg szerint …*).
I can say what the text says the doctor must not become and what the doctor should do.
I can use the words of the healer's ethos (*orvosi etosz*, *hivatástudat*).
